info:
  title: Test API
  description: A simple test API for testing swagger plugin
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
  - url: https://api.example.com/v1
    description: Test server
paths:
  /users:
    get:
      summary: List all users
      operationId: listUsers
      tags:
        - users
      responses:
        '200':
          description: A list of users
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
    post:
      summary: Create a user
      operationId: createUser
      tags:
        - users
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/NewUser'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: User created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
  /users/{userId}:
    get:
      summary: Get a user by ID
      operationId: getUser
      tags:
        - users
      parameters:
        - name: userId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
      responses:
        '200':
          description: User details
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
        '404':
          description: User not found
components:
  schemas:
    User:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: integer
        name:
          type: string
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
    NewUser:
      type: object
      required:
        - name
        - email
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
        email:
          type: string
          format: email

# Deletes the Fern docs preview `pr-<N>` that _fern_docs_preview_copy.yml created
# for pull request <N>.
#
# Callers trigger this on `pull_request_target: closed`, which runs the
# workflow from the base branch with repository secrets. The job checks out
# only the fern directory of the default branch, to read the organization
# from fern.config.json, and never checks out pull request code.
#
# Setup required in the consuming repo:
#
#   fern-docs-preview-delete-copy.yml
#     on:
#       pull_request_target:
#         types: [closed]
#     permissions: {}
#     jobs:
#       delete:
#         permissions:
#           contents: read
#           id-token: write
#         uses: NVIDIA/docs-builder/.github/workflows/_fern_docs_preview_delete_copy.yml@main
#         secrets:
#           DOCS_FERN_AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME: ${{ secrets.DOCS_FERN_AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME }}
#           DOCS_FERN_SECRET_ID: ${{ secrets.DOCS_FERN_SECRET_ID }}
#
# With a repository OIDC subject that includes repo, event_name,
# workflow_ref, and job_workflow_ref, these runs have:
#
#   event_name:       pull_request_target
#   workflow_ref:     <owner>/<repo>/.github/workflows/fern-docs-preview-delete-copy.yml@refs/heads/<default-branch>
#   job_workflow_ref: NVIDIA/docs-builder/.github/workflows/_fern_docs_preview_delete_copy.yml@refs/heads/main

name: "Preview Fern Docs: Delete"

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      aws-region:
        description: AWS region containing the Fern token secret
        required: false
        type: string
        default: us-east-2
      fern-directory:
        description: Path to the fern directory relative to the repository root
        required: false
        type: string
        default: fern
      fern-version:
        description: fern-api version to install from npm (default is the version in fern.config.json)
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      node-version:
        description: Node.js version used to run the Fern CLI
        required: false
        type: string
        default: '22.12.0'
    secrets:
      DOCS_FERN_AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME:
        description: AWS IAM role ARN used to read the Fern token
        required: true
      DOCS_FERN_SECRET_ID:
        description: AWS Secrets Manager name or ARN containing the Fern token
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  delete:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && github.event.action == 'closed' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Validate inputs
        env:
          FERN_DIRECTORY: ${{ inputs.fern-directory }}
          FERN_VERSION: ${{ inputs.fern-version }}
          AWS_REGION_INPUT: ${{ inputs.aws-region }}
          NODE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.node-version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SEMVER='^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$'
          if [[ ! "$FERN_DIRECTORY" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_./-]*$ ]] || [[ "/$FERN_DIRECTORY/" == */../* ]]; then
            echo "::error::fern-directory must be a relative path without '..' segments"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -n "$FERN_VERSION" ] && [[ ! "$FERN_VERSION" =~ $SEMVER ]]; then
            echo "::error::fern-version must be an exact version such as 5.80.2"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ ! "$AWS_REGION_INPUT" =~ ^[a-z]{2}(-[a-z]+)+-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::aws-region must be an AWS region name such as us-east-2"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ ! "$NODE_VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+){0,2}$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::node-version must be a Node.js version such as 22.12.0"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Checkout fern configuration from the default branch
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          sparse-checkout: ${{ inputs.fern-directory }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ inputs.node-version }}

      - name: Install Fern CLI
        env:
          FERN_CONFIG: ${{ inputs.fern-directory }}/fern.config.json
          FERN_VERSION: ${{ inputs.fern-version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SEMVER='^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$'
          VERSION="${FERN_VERSION:-$(jq -r .version "$FERN_CONFIG")}"
          if [[ ! "$VERSION" =~ $SEMVER ]]; then
            echo "::error::Fern CLI version '${VERSION}' must be an exact version such as 5.80.2"
            exit 1
          fi
          npm install -g "fern-api@${VERSION}"
          fern --version

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@e6de054238d6b7531b4efff3b6587d9aade6a06c # v6.2.3
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.DOCS_FERN_AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME }}
          aws-region: ${{ inputs.aws-region }}
          mask-aws-account-id: true

      - name: Read Fern token
        uses: aws-actions/aws-secretsmanager-get-secrets@2297f9a879480a9e3af9b293ed15c70caf8e1c88 # v3.0.2
        with:
          secret-ids: |
            FERN_TOKEN,${{ secrets.DOCS_FERN_SECRET_ID }}

      - name: Delete preview deployment
        env:
          FERN_DIRECTORY: ${{ inputs.fern-directory }}
          PREVIEW_ID: pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          cd "$(dirname "$FERN_DIRECTORY")"
          fern docs preview delete --id "$PREVIEW_ID" \
            || echo "Preview deletion returned non-zero; it may not exist or may already be gone"

# Workflow 1 of 2 for Fern doc previews.
#
# Collects fern/ sources and PR metadata from the (possibly untrusted) PR
# branch and uploads them as an artifact. No secrets are used here, so this is
# safe to run on fork PRs using the regular pull_request trigger.
#
# The companion workflow (_fern_docs_preview_comment.yml) picks up the
# artifact, reads the Fern token from AWS Secrets Manager, builds the preview,
# and posts the PR comment.
# When the PR closes, _fern_docs_preview_cleanup.yml deletes the preview.
#
# Setup required in the consuming repo:
#
# 1. FOUR caller workflows are required — two pairs following the same
#    fork-safe handoff pattern:
#
#    fern-docs-preview-build.yml   (this half — build pair)
#      on:
#        pull_request:
#          paths: ['fern/**', ...]   # repo-specific path filter
#      jobs:
#        collect:
#          uses: NVIDIA-NeMo/FW-CI-templates/.github/workflows/_fern_docs_preview_build.yml@vX.Y.Z
#
#    fern-docs-preview-comment.yml   (companion half — build pair)
#      on:
#        workflow_run:
#          workflows: ["Preview Fern Docs: Build"]
#          types: [completed]
#      jobs:
#        preview:
#          uses: NVIDIA-NeMo/FW-CI-templates/.github/workflows/_fern_docs_preview_comment.yml@vX.Y.Z
#          permissions:
#            actions: read
#            id-token: write
#            pull-requests: write
#          secrets:
#            DOCS_FERN_AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME: ${{ secrets.DOCS_FERN_AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME }}
#            DOCS_FERN_SECRET_ID: ${{ secrets.DOCS_FERN_SECRET_ID }}
#
#    fern-docs-preview-close.yml   (close half — cleanup pair, no secrets)
#      on:
#        pull_request:
#          types: [closed]
#      jobs:
#        close:
#          uses: NVIDIA-NeMo/FW-CI-templates/.github/workflows/_fern_docs_preview_close_collect.yml@vX.Y.Z
#
#    fern-docs-preview-cleanup.yml   (companion half — cleanup pair)
#      on:
#        workflow_run:
#          workflows: ["Preview Fern Docs: Close"]
#          types: [completed]
#      jobs:
#        cleanup:
#          uses: NVIDIA-NeMo/FW-CI-templates/.github/workflows/_fern_docs_preview_cleanup.yml@vX.Y.Z
#          permissions:
#            actions: read
#            id-token: write
#          secrets:
#            DOCS_FERN_AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME: ${{ secrets.DOCS_FERN_AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME }}
#            DOCS_FERN_SECRET_ID: ${{ secrets.DOCS_FERN_SECRET_ID }}
#
# 2. If you override `artifact-name` here, pass the same value to the comment
#    workflow. The default (`fern-preview`) works when there is only one Fern
#    instance in the repo.
#
# 3. Configure GitHub OIDC trust and an AWS role that can read the Fern token
#    from Secrets Manager.
#
# 4. The default fern/ directory is at the repository root. Override
#    `fern-directory` if it is elsewhere.
#

name: "Preview Fern Docs: Build"

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      artifact-name:
        description: Name of the artifact to upload (must match the value used in the companion comment workflow)
        required: false
        type: string
        default: fern-preview
      fern-directory:
        description: Path to the fern directory relative to the repository root
        required: false
        type: string
        default: fern

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  collect:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PR
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Save PR metadata
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.head_ref }}
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p preview-metadata
          echo "$PR_NUMBER" > preview-metadata/pr_number
          echo "$HEAD_REF" > preview-metadata/head_ref
          git diff --name-only "origin/${BASE_REF}...HEAD" -- '*.mdx' > preview-metadata/changed_mdx_files 2>/dev/null || true

      - name: Normalize fern directory
        if: inputs.fern-directory != 'fern'
        run: mv "${{ inputs.fern-directory }}" fern

      - name: Upload fern sources and metadata
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.artifact-name }}
          path: |
            fern/
            preview-metadata/
          retention-days: 1

# Reusable workflow for publishing a static documentation artifact to Review S3.
# Call this only from a trusted workflow_run caller on the default branch.

name: "Docs Review S3: Reusable Upload"

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      artifact-name:
        description: Name of the documentation artifact from the triggering workflow run.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: review-s3-sphinx
      comment-marker:
        description: Marker used to find and update the sticky PR comment.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "<!-- docs-review-s3 -->"
      docset-subdir:
        description: Subdirectory below the PR prefix for this docset.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: sphinx
      metadata-artifact-name:
        description: Name of the metadata artifact from the triggering workflow run.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: review-s3-metadata
      s3-bucket:
        description: Review S3 bucket name.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: nvidia-docs-review-github
      s3-project-prefix:
        description: Provider/project prefix below the Review S3 bucket.
        required: true
        type: string
    secrets:
      DOCS_REVIEW_S3_ROLE_ARN:
        description: AWS role ARN allowed to write the project Review S3 prefix.
        required: true

permissions:
  actions: read
  id-token: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  upload:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Validate configuration
        id: config
        env:
          CLOUDFRONT_URL: https://d3udx3nm3inpkm.cloudfront.net
          DOCSET_SUBDIR: ${{ inputs.docset-subdir }}
          ROLE_ARN: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REVIEW_S3_ROLE_ARN }}
          S3_BUCKET: ${{ inputs.s3-bucket }}
          S3_PROJECT_PREFIX: ${{ inputs.s3-project-prefix }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          validate_relative_path() {
            local name="$1"
            local value="$2"
            case "${value}" in
              *..*|/*|*\\*|*$'\n'*|*$'\r'*)
                echo "::error::${name} cannot contain '..', a leading slash, a backslash, or a newline: ${value}"
                return 1
                ;;
            esac
          }

          require_nonempty() {
            local name="$1"
            local value="$2"
            if [ -z "${value}" ]; then
              echo "::error::${name} is required."
              return 1
            fi
          }

          require_nonempty ROLE_ARN "${ROLE_ARN}"
          require_nonempty CLOUDFRONT_URL "${CLOUDFRONT_URL}"
          require_nonempty S3_BUCKET "${S3_BUCKET}"
          require_nonempty S3_PROJECT_PREFIX "${S3_PROJECT_PREFIX}"
          validate_relative_path S3_PROJECT_PREFIX "${S3_PROJECT_PREFIX}"
          validate_relative_path DOCSET_SUBDIR "${DOCSET_SUBDIR}"

          cloudfront_url="${CLOUDFRONT_URL%/}"
          project_prefix="${S3_PROJECT_PREFIX#/}"
          project_prefix="${project_prefix%/}"
          docset_subdir="${DOCSET_SUBDIR#/}"
          docset_subdir="${docset_subdir%/}"

          {
            echo "cloudfront_url=${cloudfront_url}"
            echo "project_prefix=${project_prefix}"
            echo "docset_subdir=${docset_subdir}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: Download Review S3 metadata
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.metadata-artifact-name }}
          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          path: review-s3-metadata

      - name: Download documentation artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.artifact-name }}
          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          path: review-s3-artifact

      - name: Read Review S3 metadata
        id: metadata
        env:
          CLOUDFRONT_URL: ${{ steps.config.outputs.cloudfront_url }}
          DOCSET_SUBDIR: ${{ steps.config.outputs.docset_subdir }}
          S3_PROJECT_PREFIX: ${{ steps.config.outputs.project_prefix }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          pr_number="$(tr -d '\r\n' < review-s3-metadata/pr_number)"
          case "${pr_number}" in
            ''|*[!0-9]*)
              echo "::error::Invalid PR number in Review S3 metadata: ${pr_number}"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac

          docset_path="${DOCSET_SUBDIR:+/${DOCSET_SUBDIR}}"
          s3_prefix="${S3_PROJECT_PREFIX}/${pr_number}${docset_path}"
          review_url="${CLOUDFRONT_URL}/${s3_prefix}/index.html"

          {
            echo "pr_number=${pr_number}"
            echo "review_url=${review_url}"
            echo "s3_prefix=${s3_prefix}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v6
        with:
          aws-region: us-east-2
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REVIEW_S3_ROLE_ARN }}
          mask-aws-account-id: true

      - name: Sync documentation to Review S3
        env:
          S3_BUCKET: ${{ inputs.s3-bucket }}
          S3_PREFIX: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.s3_prefix }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -f review-s3-artifact/index.html
          aws s3 sync review-s3-artifact "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${S3_PREFIX}" \
            --exclude .buildinfo \
            --exclude .doctrees \
            --delete

      - name: Post or update PR comment
        env:
          COMMENT_MARKER: ${{ inputs.comment-marker }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.pr_number }}
          REVIEW_URL: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.review_url }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          {
            echo "### Docs Review S3"
            echo
            echo "- Sphinx: [open preview](${REVIEW_URL})"
            echo
            echo "<${REVIEW_URL}>"
            echo
            echo "${COMMENT_MARKER}"
          } > comment.md

          comment_id="$(
            gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" \
              --jq ".[] | select(.body | contains(\"${COMMENT_MARKER}\")) | .id" |
              tr -d '\r' |
              head -n 1
          )"

          body="$(cat comment.md)"
          if [ -n "${comment_id}" ]; then
            gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/comments/${comment_id}" \
              -X PATCH \
              -f body="${body}"
          else
            gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" \
              -f body="${body}"
          fi

# Trusted half of the Review S3 cleanup flow. Runs from the default branch after
# the close collector completes and delegates AWS deletion to a reusable workflow
# so GitHub OIDC can bind both workflow_ref and job_workflow_ref.

name: "Docs Review S3: Cleanup"

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Docs Review S3: Close"]
    types: [completed]

jobs:
  cleanup:
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    permissions:
      actions: read
      id-token: write
      pull-requests: write
    uses: NVIDIA/docs-builder/.github/workflows/_docs-review-s3-cleanup.yml@main
    with:
      close-artifact-name: review-s3-close
      s3-bucket: nvidia-docs-review-github
      s3-project-prefix: github/nvidia/docs-builder
    secrets:
      DOCS_REVIEW_S3_ROLE_ARN: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REVIEW_S3_ROLE_ARN }}

# Deletes the pr-<N> Fern preview when PR <N> closes. Runs from the base
# branch and never checks out PR code.

name: "Preview Fern Docs: Delete"

on:  # zizmor: ignore[dangerous-triggers] -- no PR code is checked out or run
  pull_request_target:
    types: [closed]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  delete:
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    uses: NVIDIA/docs-builder/.github/workflows/_fern_docs_preview_delete_copy.yml@main  # zizmor: ignore[unpinned-uses] -- Fern OIDC trust pins refs/heads/main
    with:
      fern-directory: docs/fern
    secrets:
      DOCS_FERN_AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME: ${{ secrets.DOCS_FERN_AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME }}
      DOCS_FERN_SECRET_ID: ${{ secrets.DOCS_FERN_SECRET_ID }}

# Untrusted close collector for Review S3 cleanup. This workflow uses no AWS
# credentials and only records the closed PR number for the trusted workflow_run
# cleanup workflow.

name: "Docs Review S3: Close"

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [closed]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  collect:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Save close metadata
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p review-s3-close
          printf '%s\n' "${PR_NUMBER}" > review-s3-close/pr_number

      - name: Upload close metadata
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: review-s3-close
          path: review-s3-close/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

# Publishes the Fern documentation site.
#
# Callers define their own trigger (push to main, tag, workflow_dispatch) and
# concurrency group. This workflow only handles the publish step.
#
# Required configuration:
# - GitHub OIDC trust for the caller and this pinned reusable workflow.
# - An AWS role that can read the configured Fern secret.
# - Caller permission: id-token: write.
#
# The job installs fern-api from npm. To run a patched CLI, set `fern-package`
# to a fern-api-*.tgz release asset URL from github.com/mikemckiernan/fern and
# `fern-package-sha256` to its digest.

name: Publish Fern Docs

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      aws-region:
        description: AWS region containing the Fern token secret
        required: false
        type: string
        default: us-east-2
      fern-directory:
        description: Path to the fern directory relative to the repository root
        required: false
        type: string
        default: fern
      fern-version:

              -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/fern-api.tgz" "$FERN_PACKAGE"
            echo "${FERN_PACKAGE_SHA256}  $RUNNER_TEMP/fern-api.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
            npm install -g --ignore-scripts "$RUNNER_TEMP/fern-api.tgz"

            export FERN_NO_VERSION_REDIRECTION=true

          fi
          fern --version

      - name: Detect Fern libraries field
        id: libraries
        env:
          DOCS_YML: ${{ inputs.fern-directory }}/docs.yml
        run: |
          if [ -f "$DOCS_YML" ] && grep -Eq '^libraries:[[:space:]]*' "$DOCS_YML"; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@e6de054238d6b7531b4efff3b6587d9aade6a06c # v6.2.3
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.DOCS_FERN_AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME }}
          aws-region: ${{ inputs.aws-region }}
          mask-aws-account-id: true

      - name: Read Fern token
        uses: aws-actions/aws-secretsmanager-get-secrets@2297f9a879480a9e3af9b293ed15c70caf8e1c88 # v3.0.2
        with:
          secret-ids: |
            FERN_TOKEN,${{ secrets.DOCS_FERN_SECRET_ID }}

      - name: Generate library reference MDX (autodocs)
        if: steps.libraries.outputs.present == 'true'
        env:
          FERN_DIRECTORY: ${{ inputs.fern-directory }}
        run: |
          cd "$(dirname "$FERN_DIRECTORY")"
          fern docs md generate

      - name: Publish Docs
        env:
          FERN_DIRECTORY: ${{ inputs.fern-directory }}
        run: |
          cd "$(dirname "$FERN_DIRECTORY")"
          fern generate --docs

# Workflow 2 of 2 for Fern doc previews.
#
# Triggered by workflow_run after the companion build workflow completes.
# Downloads the fern/ artifact, reads the Fern token from AWS Secrets Manager,
# builds a preview, and posts a stable comment on the PR. This workflow never
# checks out the PR branch directly, keeping secrets isolated from untrusted
# code.
#
# Required configuration:
# - GitHub OIDC trust for the caller and this pinned reusable workflow.
# - An AWS role that can read the configured Fern secret.
# - Caller permission: id-token: write.

name: "Preview Fern Docs: Comment"

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      aws-region:
        description: AWS region containing the Fern token secret
        required: false
        type: string
        default: us-east-2
      artifact-name:
        description: Name of the artifact uploaded by the build workflow
        required: false
        type: string
        default: fern-preview
    secrets:
      DOCS_FERN_AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME:
        description: AWS IAM role ARN used to read the Fern token
        required: true
      DOCS_FERN_SECRET_ID:
        description: AWS Secrets Manager name or ARN containing the Fern token
        required: true
jobs:
  preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
      actions: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Download fern sources and metadata
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.artifact-name }}
          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          path: fern-preview

      - name: Read PR metadata
        id: metadata
        run: |
          printf 'pr_number=%s\n' "$(cat fern-preview/preview-metadata/pr_number)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          printf 'head_ref=%s\n' "$(cat fern-preview/preview-metadata/head_ref)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: '22.12.0'

      - name: Install Fern CLI
        run: npm install -g fern-api@5.56.3

      - name: Detect Fern libraries field
        id: libraries
        run: |
          DOCS_YML="fern-preview/fern/docs.yml"
          if [ -f "$DOCS_YML" ] && grep -Eq '^libraries:[[:space:]]*' "$DOCS_YML"; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@e6de054238d6b7531b4efff3b6587d9aade6a06c # v6.2.3
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.DOCS_FERN_AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME }}
          aws-region: ${{ inputs.aws-region }}
          mask-aws-account-id: true

      - name: Read Fern token
        uses: aws-actions/aws-secretsmanager-get-secrets@2297f9a879480a9e3af9b293ed15c70caf8e1c88 # v3.0.2
        with:
          secret-ids: |
            FERN_TOKEN,${{ secrets.DOCS_FERN_SECRET_ID }}

      - name: Generate library reference MDX (autodocs)
        if: steps.libraries.outputs.present == 'true'
        working-directory: fern-preview/fern
        run: fern docs md generate

      - name: Generate preview URL
        id: generate-docs
        env:
          HEAD_REF: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.head_ref }}
        working-directory: fern-preview/fern
        run: |
          OUTPUT=$(fern generate --docs --preview --id "$HEAD_REF" 2>&1)
          echo "$OUTPUT"
          URL=$(echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -oP 'Published docs to \K.*(?= \()')
          if [ -z "$URL" ]; then
            echo "::error::Failed to generate preview URL. See fern output above."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "preview_url=$URL" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          {
            echo "## :herb: Fern docs preview"
            echo ""
            echo "[Open preview]($URL)"
            echo ""
            echo "<$URL>"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Build page links for changed MDX files
        id: page-links
        env:
          PREVIEW_URL: ${{ steps.generate-docs.outputs.preview_url }}
        run: |
          CHANGED_FILES=""
          if [ -f fern-preview/preview-metadata/changed_mdx_files ]; then
            CHANGED_FILES=$(cat fern-preview/preview-metadata/changed_mdx_files)
          fi

          if [ -z "$CHANGED_FILES" ] || [ -z "$PREVIEW_URL" ]; then
            echo "page_links=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0
          fi

          BASE_URL=$(echo "$PREVIEW_URL" | grep -oP 'https?://[^/]+')
          FILES_PARAM=$(echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//' \
            | python3 -c "import sys, urllib.parse; print(urllib.parse.quote(sys.stdin.read().strip(), safe=',/'))")
          RESPONSE=$(curl -sf -H "FERN_TOKEN: $FERN_TOKEN" "${PREVIEW_URL}/api/fern-docs/get-slug-for-file?files=${FILES_PARAM}" 2>/dev/null) || {
            echo "page_links=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0
          }

          PAGE_LINKS=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r --arg url "$BASE_URL" \
            '.mappings[] | select(.slug != null) | "- [\(.slug)](\($url)/\(.slug))"')

          if [ -n "$PAGE_LINKS" ]; then
            { echo "page_links<<EOF"; echo "$PAGE_LINKS"; echo "EOF"; } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            {
              echo ""
              echo "### Changed pages"
              echo ""
              echo "$PAGE_LINKS"
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          else
            echo "page_links=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Post or update PR comment
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.pr_number }}
          PREVIEW_URL: ${{ steps.generate-docs.outputs.preview_url }}
          PAGE_LINKS: ${{ steps.page-links.outputs.page_links }}
        run: |
          BODY=":herb: **Preview your docs:** <${PREVIEW_URL}>"
          if [ -n "${PAGE_LINKS}" ]; then
            BODY="${BODY}

          Here are the markdown pages you've updated:
          ${PAGE_LINKS}"
          fi

          MARKER="<!-- preview-docs -->"
          BODY="${BODY}

          <!-- fern-preview-url: ${PREVIEW_URL} -->
          ${MARKER}"

          COMMENT_ID=$(gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" \
            --jq ".[] | select(.body | contains(\"${MARKER}\")) | .id" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)

          if [ -n "$COMMENT_ID" ]; then
            gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/issues/comments/${COMMENT_ID}" \
              -X PATCH -f body="$BODY"
          else
            gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" \
              -f body="$BODY"
          fi

# Builds a Fern docs preview for a pull request that copy-pr-bot mirrored to a
# `pull-request/<N>` branch, and posts the preview URL on PR <N>.
#
# copy-pr-bot mirrors a PR commit only after it is trusted: automatically for
# signed commits from trusted authors, otherwise after a maintainer comments
# `/ok to test <SHA>` on the PR. Because the mirror is a branch in the base
# repository, this workflow runs on `push` with repository secrets and a full
# git checkout, so Fern git-ref (`ref:`) versions resolve. Review changes to
# `.github/` and `fern/` before approving a commit: the approved commit's
# caller workflow and Fern sources run with the Fern token. The job fails
# before it reads the Fern token unless copy-pr-bot pushed the branch, so a
# `pull-request/*` branch that a repository writer pushes directly cannot read
# the token.
#
# Setup required in the consuming repo:
#
# 1. Install the copy-pr-bot GitHub App and add `.github/copy-pr-bot.yaml`:
#
#      enabled: true
#
# 2. Caller workflows:
#
#    fern-docs-preview-copy.yml
#      on:
#        push:
#          branches:
#            - "pull-request/[0-9]+"
#      concurrency:
#        group: fern-docs-preview-copy-${{ github.ref }}
#        cancel-in-progress: true
#      permissions: {}
#      jobs:
#        preview:
#          permissions:
#            contents: read
#            id-token: write
#            pull-requests: write
#          uses: NVIDIA/docs-builder/.github/workflows/_fern_docs_preview_copy.yml@main
#          secrets:
#            DOCS_FERN_AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME: ${{ secrets.DOCS_FERN_AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME }}
#            DOCS_FERN_SECRET_ID: ${{ secrets.DOCS_FERN_SECRET_ID }}
#
#    fern-docs-preview-delete-copy.yml  (see _fern_docs_preview_delete_copy.yml)
#
# 3. Grant the Fern token through GitHub OIDC. With a repository OIDC subject
#    that includes repo, event_name, workflow_ref, and job_workflow_ref, these
#    runs have:
#
#      event_name:       push
#      workflow_ref:     <owner>/<repo>/.github/workflows/fern-docs-preview-copy.yml@refs/heads/pull-request/<N>
#      job_workflow_ref: NVIDIA/docs-builder/.github/workflows/_fern_docs_preview_copy.yml@refs/heads/main
#
#    so the AWS role trust needs a `refs/heads/pull-request/*` pattern for the
#    caller. A trust that allows only `workflow_run` does not match.

# The Fern CLI defaults to the `version` in fern.config.json. Set
# `fern-version` to pin another npm release. Both values must be exact
# versions such as 5.80.2, so the job installs only a published fern-api
# release from npm before it reads the Fern token. To run a patched CLI, set
# `fern-package` to a fern-api-*.tgz release asset URL from
# github.com/mikemckiernan/fern and `fern-package-sha256` to its digest.

name: "Preview Fern Docs"

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      aws-region:
        description: AWS region containing the Fern token secret
        required: false
        type: string
        default: us-east-2
      fern-directory:
        description: Path to the fern directory relative to the repository root
        required: false
        type: string
        default: fern
      fern-version:
        description: fern-api version to install from npm (default is the version in fern.config.json)
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      fern-package:
        description: URL of a fern-api release tarball from github.com/mikemckiernan/fern; overrides fern-version and requires fern-package-sha256
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      fern-package-sha256:
        description: SHA-256 of the fern-package tarball
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      node-version:
        description: Node.js version used to run the Fern CLI
        required: false
        type: string
        default: '22.12.0'
    secrets:
      DOCS_FERN_AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME:
        description: AWS IAM role ARN used to read the Fern token
        required: true
      DOCS_FERN_SECRET_ID:
        description: AWS Secrets Manager name or ARN containing the Fern token
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  preview:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/pull-request/') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Validate inputs
        env:
          FERN_DIRECTORY: ${{ inputs.fern-directory }}
          FERN_VERSION: ${{ inputs.fern-version }}
          FERN_PACKAGE: ${{ inputs.fern-package }}
          FERN_PACKAGE_SHA256: ${{ inputs.fern-package-sha256 }}
          AWS_REGION_INPUT: ${{ inputs.aws-region }}
          NODE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.node-version }}
          PUSH_SENDER_ID: ${{ github.event.sender.id }}
          # User ID of copy-pr-bot[bot], the copy-pr-bot GitHub App bot account.
          COPY_PR_BOT_USER_ID: '138252374'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$PUSH_SENDER_ID" != "$COPY_PR_BOT_USER_ID" ]; then
            echo "::error::pull-request/* branches must be pushed by copy-pr-bot (user ID ${COPY_PR_BOT_USER_ID}); this push came from user ID ${PUSH_SENDER_ID}"
            exit 1
          fi
          SEMVER='^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$'
          if [[ ! "$FERN_DIRECTORY" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_./-]*$ ]] || [[ "/$FERN_DIRECTORY/" == */../* ]]; then
            echo "::error::fern-directory must be a relative path without '..' segments"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -n "$FERN_VERSION" ] && [[ ! "$FERN_VERSION" =~ $SEMVER ]]; then
            echo "::error::fern-version must be an exact version such as 5.80.2"
            exit 1
          fi
          FERN_PACKAGE_PATTERN='^https://github\.com/mikemckiernan/fern/releases/download/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*/fern-api-[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*\.tgz$'
          if [ -n "$FERN_PACKAGE" ]; then
            if [[ ! "$FERN_PACKAGE" =~ $FERN_PACKAGE_PATTERN ]]; then
              echo "::error::fern-package must be a fern-api-*.tgz release asset URL under https://github.com/mikemckiernan/fern/releases/download/"
              exit 1
            fi
            if [[ ! "$FERN_PACKAGE_SHA256" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then
              echo "::error::fern-package requires fern-package-sha256, a lowercase hex SHA-256 digest"
              exit 1
            fi
            if [ -n "$FERN_VERSION" ]; then
              echo "::error::Set fern-version or fern-package, not both"
              exit 1
            fi
          elif [ -n "$FERN_PACKAGE_SHA256" ]; then
            echo "::error::fern-package-sha256 requires fern-package"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ ! "$AWS_REGION_INPUT" =~ ^[a-z]{2}(-[a-z]+)+-[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::aws-region must be an AWS region name such as us-east-2"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ ! "$NODE_VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+){0,2}$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::node-version must be a Node.js version such as 22.12.0"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Resolve pull request
        id: pr
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ ! "$REF_NAME" =~ ^pull-request/([0-9]+)$ ]]; then

            exit 1
          fi
          PR_NUMBER="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
          BASE_REF=$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}" --jq .base.ref)
          echo "number=${PR_NUMBER}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "base_ref=${BASE_REF}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Checkout approved commit
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: List changed MDX files
        id: changed
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.base_ref }}
        run: |
          git diff --name-only "origin/${BASE_REF}...HEAD" -- '*.mdx' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/changed_mdx_files" 2>/dev/null || true

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ inputs.node-version }}

      - name: Install Fern CLI
        env:
          FERN_CONFIG: ${{ inputs.fern-directory }}/fern.config.json
          FERN_VERSION: ${{ inputs.fern-version }}
          FERN_PACKAGE: ${{ inputs.fern-package }}
          FERN_PACKAGE_SHA256: ${{ inputs.fern-package-sha256 }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -n "$FERN_PACKAGE" ]; then
            curl --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL --retry 3 \
              -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/fern-api.tgz" "$FERN_PACKAGE"
            echo "${FERN_PACKAGE_SHA256}  $RUNNER_TEMP/fern-api.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
            npm install -g --ignore-scripts "$RUNNER_TEMP/fern-api.tgz"
            # Keep the fork CLI from re-running the fern.config.json version from npm.
            export FERN_NO_VERSION_REDIRECTION=true
            echo "FERN_NO_VERSION_REDIRECTION=true" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          else
            SEMVER='^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$'
            VERSION="${FERN_VERSION:-$(jq -r .version "$FERN_CONFIG")}"
            if [[ ! "$VERSION" =~ $SEMVER ]]; then
              echo "::error::Fern CLI version '${VERSION}' must be an exact version such as 5.80.2"
              exit 1
            fi
            npm install -g "fern-api@${VERSION}"
          fi
          fern --version

      - name: Check docs
        env:
          FERN_DIRECTORY: ${{ inputs.fern-directory }}
        run: |
          cd "$(dirname "$FERN_DIRECTORY")"
          fern check

      - name: Detect Fern libraries field
        id: libraries
        env:
          DOCS_YML: ${{ inputs.fern-directory }}/docs.yml
        run: |
          if [ -f "$DOCS_YML" ] && grep -Eq '^libraries:[[:space:]]*' "$DOCS_YML"; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@e6de054238d6b7531b4efff3b6587d9aade6a06c # v6.2.3
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.DOCS_FERN_AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME }}
          aws-region: ${{ inputs.aws-region }}
          mask-aws-account-id: true

      - name: Read Fern token
        uses: aws-actions/aws-secretsmanager-get-secrets@2297f9a879480a9e3af9b293ed15c70caf8e1c88 # v3.0.2
        with:
          secret-ids: |
            FERN_TOKEN,${{ secrets.DOCS_FERN_SECRET_ID }}

      - name: Generate library reference MDX (autodocs)
        if: steps.libraries.outputs.present == 'true'
        env:
          FERN_DIRECTORY: ${{ inputs.fern-directory }}
        run: |
          cd "$(dirname "$FERN_DIRECTORY")"
          fern docs md generate

      - name: Generate preview URL
        id: generate-docs
        env:
          FERN_DIRECTORY: ${{ inputs.fern-directory }}
          PREVIEW_ID: pr-${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}
        run: |
          cd "$(dirname "$FERN_DIRECTORY")"
          OUTPUT=$(fern generate --docs --preview --id "$PREVIEW_ID" 2>&1)
          echo "$OUTPUT"
          URL=$(echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -oP 'Published docs to \K.*(?= \()')
          if [ -z "$URL" ]; then
            echo "::error::Failed to generate preview URL. See fern output above."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "preview_url=$URL" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          {
            echo "## :herb: Fern docs preview"
            echo ""
            echo "[Open preview]($URL)"
            echo ""
            echo "<$URL>"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Build page links for changed MDX files
        id: page-links
        env:
          PREVIEW_URL: ${{ steps.generate-docs.outputs.preview_url }}
        run: |
          CHANGED_FILES=$(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/changed_mdx_files" 2>/dev/null || true)

          if [ -z "$CHANGED_FILES" ] || [ -z "$PREVIEW_URL" ]; then
            echo "page_links=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0
          fi

          if [[ ! "$PREVIEW_URL" =~ ^https://[A-Za-z0-9-]+\.docs\.buildwithfern\.com(/|$) ]]; then
            echo "::warning::Skipping page links: preview URL is not a docs.buildwithfern.com URL"
            echo "page_links=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0
          fi
          BASE_URL=$(echo "$PREVIEW_URL" | grep -oP 'https://[^/]+')
          FILES_PARAM=$(echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//' \
            | python3 -c "import sys, urllib.parse; print(urllib.parse.quote(sys.stdin.read().strip(), safe=',/'))")
          RESPONSE=$(curl -sf -H "FERN_TOKEN: $FERN_TOKEN" "${PREVIEW_URL}/api/fern-docs/get-slug-for-file?files=${FILES_PARAM}" 2>/dev/null) || {
            echo "page_links=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0
          }

          PAGE_LINKS=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r --arg url "$BASE_URL" \
            '.mappings[] | select(.slug != null) | "- [\(.slug)](\($url)/\(.slug))"')

          if [ -n "$PAGE_LINKS" ]; then
            { echo "page_links<<EOF"; echo "$PAGE_LINKS"; echo "EOF"; } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            {
              echo ""
              echo "### Changed pages"
              echo ""
              echo "$PAGE_LINKS"
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          else
            echo "page_links=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Post or update PR comment
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}
          PREVIEW_URL: ${{ steps.generate-docs.outputs.preview_url }}
          PAGE_LINKS: ${{ steps.page-links.outputs.page_links }}
          COMMIT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          BODY=":herb: **Preview your docs:** <${PREVIEW_URL}>

          Built from ${COMMIT_SHA}."
          if [ -n "${PAGE_LINKS}" ]; then
            BODY="${BODY}

          Here are the markdown pages you've updated:
          ${PAGE_LINKS}"
          fi

          MARKER="<!-- preview-docs -->"
          BODY="${BODY}

          <!-- fern-preview-url: ${PREVIEW_URL} -->
          ${MARKER}"

          COMMENT_ID=$(gh api --paginate "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" \
            --jq ".[] | select(.user.login == \"github-actions[bot]\" and (.body | contains(\"${MARKER}\"))) | .id" \
            | tr -d '\r' | head -1)

          if [ -n "$COMMENT_ID" ]; then
            gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/comments/${COMMENT_ID}" \
              -X PATCH -f body="$BODY"
          else
            gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" \
              -f body="$BODY"
          fi

# Builds and tests the docs-builder image and builds Sphinx HTML for Review S3.
# PR builds do not push images because fork PR tokens cannot write to
# organization packages.
#
# Triggers:
#   - pull_request:  build + test image, build Sphinx HTML.
#   - push tag v*:   build + push :<semver>.
#
# Fern previews for docs/fern run from copy-pr-bot mirror branches:
#   - fern-docs-preview-copy.yml          (push pull-request/<N>: build + comment)
#   - fern-docs-preview-delete-copy.yml   (pull_request_target closed: delete preview)

name: build

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - 'release-*'
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions: {}

jobs:
  image:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v4
      - name: Detect runner UID
        id: runner-user
        run: echo "uid=$(id -u)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Docker meta
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v6
        with:
          images: |
            ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}
          # On pull_request, type=sha derives from the PR merge commit SHA (github.sha), not the PR head.
          tags: |
            type=semver,pattern={{version}}
            type=sha,format=short,prefix=sha-
          flavor: |
            latest=false
      - name: Build and export to Docker
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v7
        id: build_for_test
        with:
          context: .
          file: Dockerfile
          build-args: |
            UID=${{ steps.runner-user.outputs.uid }}
          load: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
      - name: Test image and build Sphinx docs
        run: |
          docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/work -w /work \
            "${{ steps.build_for_test.outputs.imageid }}" \
            bash -c "make install-dev && make test && rm -rf _build && make docs-html"
      - name: Save Review S3 metadata
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.head_ref }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p review-s3-metadata
          printf '%s\n' "${PR_NUMBER}" > review-s3-metadata/pr_number
          printf '%s\n' "${HEAD_REF}" > review-s3-metadata/head_ref
          printf '%s\n' "${HEAD_SHA}" > review-s3-metadata/head_sha
          printf '%s\n' "${BASE_REF}" > review-s3-metadata/base_ref
      - name: Upload Sphinx docs artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: review-s3-sphinx
          path: _build/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1
      - name: Upload Review S3 metadata
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: review-s3-metadata
          path: review-s3-metadata/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  publish-image:
    if: ${{ github.ref_type == 'tag' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v4
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v4
      - name: Docker meta
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v6
        with:
          images: |
            ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}
          tags: |
            type=semver,pattern={{version}}
          flavor: |
            latest=false
      - name: Build and export to Docker
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v7
        id: build_for_test
        with:
          context: .
          file: Dockerfile
          load: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
      - name: Test image
        run: |
          docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/work -w /work \
            "${{ steps.build_for_test.outputs.imageid }}" \
            bash -c "make install-dev && make test"
      - name: Push to Container Registry
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v7
        with:
          context: .
          file: Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      aws-region:
        description: AWS region containing the Fern token secret
        required: false
        type: string
        default: us-east-2
      artifact-name:
        description: Artifact name uploaded by the close workflow
        required: false
        type: string
        default: fern-preview-close

    secrets:
      DOCS_FERN_AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME:
        description: AWS IAM role ARN used to read the Fern token
        required: true
      DOCS_FERN_SECRET_ID:
        description: AWS Secrets Manager name or ARN containing the Fern token
        required: true
jobs:
  cleanup:

          name: ${{ inputs.artifact-name }}
          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Read preview URL
        id: preview

          # actions/upload-artifact strips the close-metadata/ prefix.
          URL=$(cat preview_url 2>/dev/null || true)
          echo "preview_url=${URL}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [ -z "$URL" ]; then
            echo "No preview URL in artifact — nothing to delete"

        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: '22.12.0'

      - name: Install Fern CLI
        if: steps.preview.outputs.preview_url != ''
        run: npm install -g fern-api@5.80.2

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        if: steps.preview.outputs.preview_url != ''
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@e6de054238d6b7531b4efff3b6587d9aade6a06c # v6.2.3
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.DOCS_FERN_AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME }}
          aws-region: ${{ inputs.aws-region }}
          mask-aws-account-id: true

      - name: Read Fern token

        uses: aws-actions/aws-secretsmanager-get-secrets@2297f9a879480a9e3af9b293ed15c70caf8e1c88 # v3.0.2
        with:
          secret-ids: |
            FERN_TOKEN,${{ secrets.DOCS_FERN_SECRET_ID }}

      - name: Delete preview deployment
        if: steps.preview.outputs.preview_url != ''
        env:
          PREVIEW_URL: ${{ steps.preview.outputs.preview_url }}
        run: |
          fern docs preview delete --url "${PREVIEW_URL}" \
            || echo "Preview deletion returned non-zero — it may already be gone"

# Reusable workflow for deleting Review S3 objects after a pull request closes.
# Call this only from a trusted workflow_run caller on the default branch.

name: "Docs Review S3: Reusable Cleanup"

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      close-artifact-name:
        description: Name of the close metadata artifact from the triggering workflow run.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: review-s3-close
      comment-marker:
        description: Marker used to find and update the sticky PR comment.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "<!-- docs-review-s3 -->"
      s3-bucket:
        description: Review S3 bucket name.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: nvidia-docs-review-github
      s3-project-prefix:
        description: Provider/project prefix below the Review S3 bucket.
        required: true
        type: string
    secrets:
      DOCS_REVIEW_S3_ROLE_ARN:
        description: AWS role ARN allowed to delete the project Review S3 prefix.
        required: true

permissions:
  actions: read
  id-token: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  cleanup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Validate configuration
        id: config
        env:
          ROLE_ARN: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REVIEW_S3_ROLE_ARN }}
          S3_BUCKET: ${{ inputs.s3-bucket }}
          S3_PROJECT_PREFIX: ${{ inputs.s3-project-prefix }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          require_nonempty() {
            local name="$1"
            local value="$2"
            if [ -z "${value}" ]; then
              echo "::error::${name} is required."
              return 1
            fi
          }

          require_nonempty ROLE_ARN "${ROLE_ARN}"
          require_nonempty S3_BUCKET "${S3_BUCKET}"
          require_nonempty S3_PROJECT_PREFIX "${S3_PROJECT_PREFIX}"
          case "${S3_PROJECT_PREFIX}" in
            *..*|/*|*\\*|*$'\n'*|*$'\r'*)
              echo "::error::S3_PROJECT_PREFIX cannot contain '..', a leading slash, a backslash, or a newline: ${S3_PROJECT_PREFIX}"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac

          project_prefix="${S3_PROJECT_PREFIX#/}"
          project_prefix="${project_prefix%/}"

          {
            echo "project_prefix=${project_prefix}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: Download close metadata
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.close-artifact-name }}
          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          path: review-s3-close

      - name: Read close metadata
        id: metadata
        env:
          S3_PROJECT_PREFIX: ${{ steps.config.outputs.project_prefix }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          pr_number="$(tr -d '\r\n' < review-s3-close/pr_number)"
          case "${pr_number}" in
            ''|*[!0-9]*)
              echo "::error::Invalid PR number in Review S3 close metadata: ${pr_number}"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac

          {
            echo "pr_number=${pr_number}"
            echo "s3_prefix=${S3_PROJECT_PREFIX}/${pr_number}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v6
        with:
          aws-region: us-east-2
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REVIEW_S3_ROLE_ARN }}
          mask-aws-account-id: true

      - name: Delete Review S3 objects
        env:
          S3_BUCKET: ${{ inputs.s3-bucket }}
          S3_PREFIX: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.s3_prefix }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          aws s3 rm --recursive "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${S3_PREFIX}"

      - name: Update PR comment
        env:
          COMMENT_MARKER: ${{ inputs.comment-marker }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.pr_number }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          {
            echo "### Docs Review S3"
            echo
            echo "Preview objects were deleted after this PR closed."
            echo
            echo "${COMMENT_MARKER}"
          } > comment.md

          comment_id="$(
            gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" \
              --jq ".[] | select(.body | contains(\"${COMMENT_MARKER}\")) | .id" |
              tr -d '\r' |
              head -n 1

# NVIDIA Product Documentation Builder

## Why

Use the images from this project to build HTML for NVIDIA product documentation using Sphinx.

The goal of putting common Sphinx packages in a container is to standardize on the tooling
and avoid repo-by-repo customizations.
If a customization is useful to one project, put the customization in this project so everyone can benefit.

## Getting the Container

1. Pull the container:

   ```console
   $ docker pull ghcr.io/nvidia/docs-builder:0.1.0
   ```

   The tag changes periodically.
   Refer to the [container registry](https://github.com/NVIDIA/docs-builder/pkgs/container/docs-builder)
   for newer tags.

## Update Your Project

If this is the first time you use the container with your project or you pulled a newer container, update the project dependencies.

1. Update the image in your GitHub workflow file:

   ```yaml
   variables:
     IMAGE: ghcr.io/nvidia/docs-builder:0.1.0
   ```

   There is more than one way to specify the image.
   Your repo might specify the image in some other way.

1. Commit and push the updates to your repo.

## Build the Documentation

1. Start the docs-builder container, referencing the repo as the `/work` directory:

   ```console
   $ docker run --rm -it -v $(pwd):/work -w /work ghcr.io/nvidia/docs-builder:0.1.0 bash
   ```

1. Inside the container, build the docs:

   ```console
   $ make <possible-arguments>

   # Or with sphinx-build.
   $ sphinx-build -m html <docs/source> <docs/_build>
   ```

## Troubleshooting Permissions Errors

If your UNIX user ID is not `1000`, you can experience permissions issues.
You can determine your ID by running `id -u` in a terminal, outside the container.
If your ID is not `1000`, the clone the docs-builder-sphinx repo and build your own container with a command like the following example:

```console
$ docker build \
    -t ghcr.io/nvidia/docs-builder:0.1.0 \
    --build-arg UID=$(id -u) .
```
